answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 60054 Country: Canada Title: Asr salah Question: I live in a city where my local masjid (close to my home i.e. 2-3 minutes drive) offers Asr salah according to Shafi’i time and another masjid located at 8 minutes drive from my home offers Asr salah according to Hanafi time. I am a Hanafi and under such circumstances am I allowed to offer Asr salah at my local masjid or I must go and offer Asr salah at a masjid that prays according to Hanafi time? Also what is the ruling if a Hanafi person leads Asr salah at my local Masjid that offers Asr salah according to Shafi’i time, in such a situation is the salah of the muqtadi valid irrespective of the Madhhab they follow? Answer ID: 60054 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 900/896/B=09/1436) When you are a Hanafi then you should offer Asr in Hanafi mosque, it is better for you. In case of compulsion, if you offer Asr salah in Shafi’i mosque according to their time then too your Asr salah shall be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
